title: fix(gateway): retire broker after retained supervisor cleanup
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the shutdown regression from #188891 (`a535fbc2d36f`). A supervisor cleanup failure recorded hours before shutdown could reject the broker close tail before database admission, read-only workers, and the spawn broker were retired. The retained broker then kept the Gateway alive until its shutdown deadline and hard-exit watchdog.

Keep the supervisor join first, attempt every later retirement step even after rejection, and preserve all failures. Classify process-supervisor shutdown failures with the existing retained-resource error family: external stops can exit successfully, while unconfirmed process ownership still refuses in-process runtime reuse (#132566). Report the original failure and owner details once across the Gateway close and CLI fallback joins. The supervisor's stored failure, process admission fence, service-child deadline, shutdown deadlines, and watchdogs remain intact.

Operator evidence: Team release `731030eb`, 2026-10-31 UTC. At 05:14:18 a service-child relay missed its five-second hard cleanup deadline and the supervisor retained the error. SIGTERM arrived at 07:20:14.5; Gateway close rejected at 07:20:21.3 with that same old failure. The process then remained idle until the shutdown deadline at 07:21:39.5 and forced SIGKILL at 07:21:41.5; systemd also had to kill the detached spawn broker.

## Evidence

- Regressions run with `OPENCLAW_VITEST_RUNTIME=node|bun node scripts/run-vitest.mjs <file> --maxWorkers=1` for `src/gateway/server.spawn-broker.test.ts` and `src/cli/gateway-cli/run-loop.direct-stop-active-work.process.test.ts`.
- The owner regression checks broker retirement, stopped database admission, and preservation of the supervisor failure. The process regression seeds a real service-child hard-deadline failure using the existing cleanup budget before SIGTERM, then checks exit code 0 within 10 seconds, one warning with generation/relay/command owner details, no close-failure bundle or hard-exit-watchdog line, and broker-child disappearance. It uses the real supervisor, Gateway runtime close wrapper, broker, and run-loop signal owners; unrelated Gateway core services are stubbed. The broker subprocess uses Node under both test runners because command brokerage is Node-specific. No production test seam was added.
- Local Codex autoreview at P1: scoped-clean against `b62b39ec931d3c94d99a50879f85237ca8978e83`, including the complete staged candidate and relevant unchanged lifecycle owners. No accepted/actionable findings. Simplification pass retained existing owners and introduced no production helper or new deadline.
- Red on pinned main base `b62b39ec931d3c94d99a50879f85237ca8978e83` under both runners: the owner regression reports zero broker-close calls; the sticky-failure process remains alive until the 60-second test limit. Green: Node owner suite 11 passed; Bun owner suite 3 passed / 7 existing Node-only cases skipped; process suite 3 passed under each runner. The process file took 23.73s (Node) / 25.19s (Bun), including child startup; shutdown itself is asserted below 10 seconds. Final owner reruns took 35.91s (Node) / 11.34s (Bun), including transform/compiler startup.
- Targeted lint, format, production typecheck, Gateway-server test typecheck, all baseline ratchets plus line-cap, and `git diff --check` pass. The final `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --base b62b39ec931d3c94d99a50879f85237ca8978e83` completes with exit 1 solely from the inherited dead-export scan below; every other selected check passes. Exact-head CI has one inherited failed test job, documented below.
- Inherited local failures reproduced on the same main base: dead-export scans report 4 production entries and 3 full-tree entries (5 unique exports). The sibling run-loop suite has 7 failed cases plus one unhandled signal-owner error: six managed-update setup failures (`No safe OpenClaw temp root is available`), followed by the same 120-second restart-upgrade timeout and `A process signal exit owner is already registered`. Candidate: 155 passed / 7 failed; base rerun of those cases: 1 passed / 7 failed / 154 skipped, same unhandled error. The independent Gateway shutdown classification suite passes all 4 tests, and the retained/fatal custody cases pass. No ignore, baseline waiver, or unrelated repair was added.

- CI at head `5a8883647fb8e0b1abda38d4ed3d503b27d16e3d`: [run 41182961464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41182961464), [failed job `checks-node-changed-compact-large-16-2`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41182961464/job/124484358942), 208 seconds. Its Bun meeting-transcript reload case fails with `Gateway SDK resource host is not bound`. On the untouched exact CI main commit `2910c0de8d7d290f9a82ca388f2893d067c06cb1`, `OPENCLAW_VITEST_RUNTIME=bun node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-plugin-reload.meeting-transcripts.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` reproduces the identical signature: 1 failed / 3 passed and the same unhandled error. The candidate also reproduces it under Node. This is inherited; no CI failure has been attributed to this change. Terminal CI result: 63 jobs passed, 26 skipped, and 2 failed. The second failure is the dependent [`openclaw/ci-gate`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41182961464/job/124487856368), reflecting the inherited test-job failure; all three PostgreSQL conformance jobs passed. No corrective push or CI rerun was needed.

Production: +46/-13 lines (net +33). Tests and fixtures: +145/-13 (net +132). The scoped 132-line allocation covers the distinct owner and process-exit regressions and their compiled subprocess fixture; the shared test-line baseline is unchanged. Documentation adds five lines. No schema, configuration, or public API changes.
